product_one_liner.value: Doxis is SER Group’s AI-first enterprise content automation/document intelligence platform for organizations to manage and process enterprise documents and automate document-centric workflows.
product_one_liner.notes: SER rebranded to Doxis in January 2026; answering about the same company/product.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or prices were found; the product is presented for contact-led enterprise sales.

named_customers.notes: Both named organizations appear among SER Group's customer references.

employee_band.notes: Tracxn search result reported 432 employees as of March 2026.

hq_location.notes: Company location page lists its Bonn address; Carlyle's acquisition announcement explicitly identifies Bonn as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Carlyle's announcement says SER was founded in 1984.

eng_blog.notes: The readable company blog index contains topical/product/marketing articles, without at least two posts describing technical implementation, architecture, infrastructure, ML, incidents, or open source.

public_docs.notes: Public learning/documentation resources are available; the product documentation includes multiple instructional pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-role list includes Full Stack AI Engineer.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed public product, documentation, AI/security and related pages did not establish a named underlying model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The certification page names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications and says Doxis is EU GDPR-compliant. GDPR is listed as requested, although it is a regulation/compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: SER announced a new investment from TA Associates on March 21, 2024. The announcement did not publicly disclose an amount; amount_usd is set to 0 to represent undisclosed, not a zero-dollar round.

raised_18mo.notes: The disclosed TA Associates investment is dated March 2024, outside the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09; no later funding round was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board is open, but lists no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive role. Sales-adjacent roles are excluded under the stated rule.

launched_6mo.notes: The release index lists product releases dated October 16 and October 26, 2026, within the six-month window; these include Doxis Doc Gen Integration and Doxis Designer/Desktop releases.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 rebrand announcement explicitly says the company enhanced its leadership, including appointment of Chief AI Officer and Chief Revenue Officer, inside the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The CRM integration page names the supported CRM integrations.
